items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: This concert was held to raise funds for a stained-glass window to be dedicated in the memory of the late Rev. Arthur Eugene Adair.

ctx.x: Even though this is a lively song, one can sense a feeling of melancholy. From the beginning of 'Kater St. Blues,' as well as throughout most of the program, the audience responded by tapping their feet and moving in rhythm to the music, in addition to their enthusiastic applause.
This concert was held to raise funds for a stained-glass window to be dedicated in the memory of the late Rev. Arthur Eugene Adair.

'This program is a fitting tribute to Rev. Adair, who encouraged and promoted all types of music in the church,' said Mrs. Thelma Adair. 'To help the church purchase its pipe organ, Rev. Adair contributed a year of his salary.'
